A '''member''' of the [[Ishi Tib]] [[species]] served the [[New Republic]] as a Lieutenant<ref>The one dot on the uniform refers to their rank as lieutenant. </ref> by around [[9 ABY]]. They served aboard [[Captain]] [[Girard]]'s cruiser to the [[Denab system]].<ref name="Part Five" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Ishi Tib]] first appeared in the [[Part Five: Shadow Warrior|fifth episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka|Ahsoka]]''.<ref name="Part Five" />
